text:
Maya: Quick question from the Q&A — folks asked for clearer dates for three items: API quota dashboard, Console model-routing UX (including per-model priority), and Optimize's cost-recommendation beta. Can we get targets + owners so teams and customers have something concrete?

Diego: Short answer: yes. Tentative windows below, but will lock after infra/SDK checks. API quota dashboard: alpha view in ~5 weeks, public canary in ~9 weeks. Console model-routing UX: design sprint this week, dev sprint next 3 weeks, canary in ~11 weeks. Optimize recommendations beta: invite-only in ~7 weeks. Owners: Priya (API), Giselle (Console UX), Liam (Optimize).

Priya: Confirming ownership for API dashboard. Plan: wire up quota ingestion -> nightly rollup -> UI preview. Need a sample telemetry payload from SDKs (size/fields). Blocking item: quota ingestion schema finalization.

Giselle: UX note — per-model priority will be opt-in (we don't want silent routing changes). We'll surface a priority slider + explanation. Beta will include a migration guide for existing routes.

Liam: For Optimize beta, early customers will get a PDF with recommended batch sizes, suggested quant levels (FP16/int8 where applicable), and an estimated cost delta. CLI flag for early adopters: `--opt-reco-beta`. We'll also include safety checks for quality regressions.

Maya: Can we have concrete dates to publish in the public roadmap? Customers wanted to know when Dedicated customers might get early access.

Diego: I'll publish a short update on Friday with canary windows. Dedicated customers can request priority canary access or a fee/commit — we'll add a link to an intake form.

Priya: Proposed rollback triggers (for canary):
``
- sustained 3xx/5xx increase > 1.5x baseline for 10m
- p95 latency > 2x SLO for >= 15m
- token-generation failure rate > 0.5% absolute increase
```
We'll add automated rollback automation for the first two.

Giselle: I'll publish mockups to the design workspace by Wed EOD and include a short script for customer-facing screenshots.

Liam: Action items from my side: finalize report template, add `--opt-reco-beta` to CLI help, and coordinate with SDKs for the flag. ETA: 2 weeks for the template, 7 weeks for invite beta.

Diego: Consolidated action list: 1) Priya finalize ingestion schema (5d) 2) Giselle publish mockups (3d) 3) Liam finish report template (14d) 4) Diego update public roadmap (Fri) 5) Maya collect customer asks and post summary.

infra-bot: Canary scheduling queued: `canary-console-routing-eu-central` -> 2024-07-01T08:00:00Z

Maya: Thanks all. I'll post an updated roadmap blurb once Diego pushes the page and will link the intake form for Dedicated canary requests. If anything slips, please update this thread so customer-facing comms stay accurate. :sparkles:
